job.title: Jobgether - Sr. AI-First Test Engineer / QA Lead

tailoring.headline: Senior AI-Enabled Test Engineer | SAP Commerce Cloud & Headless API Specialist
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs and headless commerce, I design and test data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM, build automated JUnit test suites, and lead API migrations. Skilled in AI-assisted analysis, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes and production support, I bridge business and IT to ensure high-quality e-commerce experiences.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Sr. AI-First Test Engineer / QA Lead
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Jobgether’s AI-driven hiring platform and its focus on reliable, scalable commerce experiences. With over 5 years of SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have deep expertise in headless APIs, e-commerce testing and AI-assisted quality assurance.

bullets.label: API Test Automation
bullets.text: Built and executed JUnit-based test suites for OCC REST services, ensuring API contracts and performance across headless storefronts.

bullets.label: Integration Validation
bullets.text: Designed PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and validated end-to-end flows between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee, catching integration defects before production.

bullets.label: Production Support
bullets.text: Led incident response for API migrations and catalog updates, reducing downtime by quickly reproducing and fixing issues in SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: AI-Assisted QA
bullets.text: Leveraged generative AI to generate test cases, documentation and code reviews, accelerating test coverage and knowledge sharing.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, available to start 16 December 2026.

tailoring.why_company: Jobgether’s mission to connect talent with opportunities through an AI-first platform aligns with my passion for combining cutting-edge technology and high-quality e-commerce experiences. I admire your commitment to data-driven hiring and the need for robust, scalable APIs that power seamless user journeys. Contributing my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise and AI-assisted testing will help ensure your platform remains reliable and performant as it scales.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud and AI-enhanced testing expertise to strengthen Jobgether’s AI-driven hiring platform, ensuring its commerce APIs are reliable, scalable, and deliver exceptional user experiences.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of e-commerce testing and AI-assisted QA. I’m excited about Jobgether’s AI-first vision and would love to discuss how I can help ensure robust, scalable API quality. Open to chat?
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will audit and enhance your headless API test suites, introduce AI-generated test cases and streamline PIM-ERP integration validation. My proven experience with OCC REST services and CI/CD pipelines will quickly raise test coverage and reduce release risk.
tailoring.insight: The posting highlights a need for strong API expertise in headless commerce; I have built and tested OCC REST APIs for SAP Commerce Cloud, directly matching that requirement.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Sr. AI-First Test Engineer / QA Lead – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of e-commerce testing experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am drawn to Jobgether’s AI-first hiring platform and its focus on reliable headless APIs. I can immediately boost your API test coverage, apply AI-assisted test generation, and ensure seamless PIM-ERP integrations. I have noted your emphasis on API quality and can help address it. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
